products.name: Lane Outage Handoff
products.product: A focused bowling lane outage tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent bowling centers and league-focused venues
products.problem: Desk staff, mechanics, league coordinators, and managers track lane faults, moves, temporary fixes, parts, and customer impact in different logs.
products.valueProposition: Turns bowling lane outage tracking into a visible operating queue so every unavailable or impaired lane has a current status, owner, customer plan, and verified return-to-service decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets bowling lane outage tracking software, bowling lane outage tracking tracker, bowling lane outage tracking template, and bowling lane outage tracking checklist searches.

products.problem: Scores, absent-bowler treatment, corrections, payments, standings, and exported league records can disagree after a session.
products.valueProposition: Turns bowling league result and standing reconciliation into a visible operating queue so every disputed or incomplete league session is reconciled before standings are published.
